title: Agreement sort and correction sheet
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 17 (Agreement sort and correction sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 17: Describing subjects and teachers: plurals that take the feminine. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: Describe the subjects and the teachers.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: I study eight subjects. The subjects are interesting but some are hard. The teachers are kind and patient.

questions.q: Say: The exercise books (الدَّفَاتِر) are new.
Core: Describe five subjects with an adjective each, and the teachers with one plural adjective.
questions.a: For example: الرِّيَاضِيَّاتُ صَعْبَةٌ. العُلُومُ مُمْتِعَةٌ. التَّارِيخُ مُفِيدٌ. الحَاسُوبُ سَهْلٌ. اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ جَمِيلَةٌ. المُعَلِّمُونَ لُطَفَاءُ.

questions.q: Extend: Correct the mistakes: الكُتُبُ جَدِيدُونَ. الطَّالِبَاتُ مُجْتَهِدَةٌ.
Stretch: Write a short paragraph on your online school: lessons, subjects and teachers (portal response box).
questions.a: For example: مَدْرَسَتِي عَبْرَ الإِنْتَرْنِتِ. الدُّرُوسُ قَصِيرَةٌ وَمُمْتِعَةٌ. المَوَادُّ مُفِيدَةٌ. المُعَلِّمُونَ لُطَفَاءُ.
B) الدُّرُوسُ طَوِيلَةٌ. الدُّرُوس is a non-human plural: feminine singular طَوِيلَةٌ.

questions.q: Non-human plurals take: A) a feminine singular adjective B) a masculine plural adjective
Big question: why do we say المَوَادُّ مُفِيدَةٌ?
questions.a: مَوَادّ is a non-human plural, which takes a feminine singular adjective.
